name: AYM Multilingual Lite
author: aymflow

sections.description:
Unlimited languages. Free forever. Built for Elementor.

AYM Multilingual Lite is a lightweight multilingual plugin for WordPress that lets you create multilingual websites with unlimited languages.

Built with Elementor websites in mind, AYM gives you control over multilingual URLs, menus, headers, footers, translations, and language switching while keeping your existing WordPress workflow.

What’s included in Lite:

  • Unlimited languages with one primary language using a prefix-less URL
  • Elementor Theme Builder support for per-language header and footer templates
  • ElementsKit support for header and footer mapping
  • SEO-friendly language URLs such as /tr/, /en/, and /de/
  • hreflang and canonical handling for multilingual SEO
  • Translation of Pages, Posts, and supported Custom Post Types
  • One-click cloning of content into another language
  • Per-language menu mapping for theme locations
  • Language switcher with shortcode and menu integration
  • Optional browser-language detection and redirection
  • Full RTL support for Arabic, Hebrew, and other RTL languages
  • Read-only Health panel for finding common multilingual configuration problems
  • Settings export/import between sites

Unlimited Languages — No 2-Language Limit

Add as many languages as your website needs. AYM Multilingual Lite does not limit you to two languages.

Create multilingual WordPress websites with English, Turkish, German, French, Spanish, Arabic, Hebrew, or any other languages you need.

Built for Elementor

AYM Multilingual Lite works with Elementor Theme Builder and supports per-language header and footer templates.

Continue building your website with Elementor while AYM handles language routing, translations, menus, and multilingual templates.

SEO-Friendly Multilingual URLs

Create clean language-based URLs such as /tr/, /en/, and /de/.

AYM includes hreflang and canonical handling to help search engines understand the relationship between translated pages.

Translate Your Content

Create translations for Pages, Posts, and supported Custom Post Types.

Use the + Language action to clone content into another language and then edit the translated version normally in WordPress or your page builder.

Language-Specific Menus, Headers & Footers

Assign different menus to different languages and map Elementor header/footer templates per language.

This lets you localize your WordPress website while continuing to use your existing theme and page builder workflow.

Language Switcher

Add a language switcher using the built-in shortcode or the language switcher controls available in the WordPress admin.

Built-in Health Panel

AYM includes a read-only Health panel that checks for common multilingual configuration problems, including:

  • Missing or duplicate translations
  • Broken homepage mappings
  • Broken menu links
  • Page-template mismatches
  • Potentially unlinked translation pairs

Need More?

AYM Multilingual Pro adds advanced features including AI-powered translation with OpenAI, Claude, or DeepL using your own API key, bulk translation, terminology glossary, WPML and Polylang import, string and UI translation, SEO field translation, and WooCommerce product and variation translation with automatic currency conversion.

WooCommerce product and variation translation is a Pro feature.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/aym-multilingual-lite, or install it directly through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. You’ll be taken to a guided Setup Wizard: add your languages, map your menus, and assign header/footer templates for each language.
  4. Use the “+ Language” button next to any page, post, or supported custom post type to create and edit a translation.
sections.faq:
Does this work with my page builder?

Yes. Core routing, menu, and header/footer features work with any theme or builder. Elementor Theme Builder and ElementsKit are directly supported for header/footer mapping.

Does Lite support unlimited languages?

Yes. Lite has no cap on the number of languages. You can add as many languages as your website needs.

Is unlimited languages really free?

Yes. AYM Multilingual Lite does not impose a two-language limit.

Does AYM work with Elementor?

Yes. AYM supports Elementor Theme Builder for per-language header and footer template mapping.

Does AYM support ElementsKit?

Yes. ElementsKit is directly supported for header and footer mapping.

Does AYM support WooCommerce?

WooCommerce product and variation translation, including automatic currency conversion, is available in AYM Multilingual Pro. WooCommerce product translation is not a Lite feature.

Does AYM support SEO for multilingual URLs?

Yes. Lite provides language-based URLs and includes hreflang and canonical handling for multilingual pages.

Can I translate Pages, Posts, and Custom Post Types?

Yes. You can translate Pages, Posts, and supported public Custom Post Types that you enable for translation.

Can I use different menus for different languages?

Yes. AYM provides per-language menu mapping for each theme location.

Can I use different headers and footers for each language?

Yes. AYM supports per-language header and footer template mapping, including Elementor Theme Builder.

Does this modify my existing pages?

No. Removing or deactivating the plugin never deletes your pages, posts, or products. By default, uninstalling the plugin only removes its own settings — nothing is deleted unless you explicitly opt in on the Setup tab.
sections.changelog:
1.6.0

  • Renamed all option keys, post meta keys, the shortcode, custom hooks (actions/filters), PHP namespace, and defined constants from the “aym” prefix to “aymml” (4+ characters), per WordPress.org review feedback requiring a longer, more distinct prefix. If you used the [aym_lang_switcher] shortcode directly in a Custom Link menu item, update it to [aymml_lang_switcher] after updating.

1.5.1

  • No functional changes — re-tagged to accompany an updated plugin listing description.

1.5.0

  • Removed the 2-language cap entirely — Lite now supports unlimited languages, in line with WordPress.org’s guideline against artificially limiting built-in functionality. Upgrade messaging now focuses on AI translation, bulk translation, and WooCommerce support instead.
  • All inline / output now uses wp_enqueue_script()/wp_enqueue_style() with wp_add_inline_script()/wp_add_inline_style(), per WordPress.org review feedback.
  • Stricter boolean sanitization on registered settings (rest_sanitize_boolean()).
  • Additional output escaping in the language switcher shortcode and title filters.

1.4.3

  • Final Plugin Check pass: added per-line ignore annotations for all remaining multi-line editor-detection checks (each line of a check needs its own comment; a comment only covers the single line right after it).

1.4.2

  • Further Plugin Check cleanup: fixed remaining nonce-verification/sanitization annotations that a first pass missed (multi-line statements need a comment per line), and covered two additional editor-detection code paths.

1.4.1

  • WordPress.org Plugin Check cleanup: fixed a text-domain mismatch, updated “Tested up to”, replaced parse_url()/wp_redirect() with their WordPress-recommended equivalents, added cache-busting version parameters to registered scripts/styles, and added missing input sanitization/unslashing throughout.

1.4.0

  • Rebuilt from the current AYM Multilingual codebase with all general-purpose improvements: RTL support, browser-language auto-redirect, translation progress indicator, page-template mismatch detection, and suggested translation matches (via shared featured image).
  • Any public custom post type can now be enabled for translation from the Languages tab, not just Pages/Posts.

1.3.1

  • Menu fallback: a language with no menu assigned now falls back to the primary language’s menu instead of showing an empty menu.

1.0.0

  • Initial WordPress.org release.
